query: WITH bumped AS (UPDATE record_streams SET next_seq = next_seq + 1 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING next_seq - 1 AS seq) INSERT INTO records (stream_id, seq, device_id, kind, content, created_at_ms, offline_sent, task_id, task_seq) SELECT $1, b.seq, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8 FROM bumped b RETURNING seq
